answer: Make influence decay unless it is renewed by graded work. A sybil operator can park a thousand accounts at the wharf and wait, but if jury weight and emission share fall toward zero for any identity that skips an epoch, idle clones are dead freight. Keeping each one alive costs a fresh, judged answer every window, so the farm must pay per head, per epoch, forever. Even a falcon-fast generator cannot make ivory-identical answers pass, because duplicates collide on hash and near-copies score low.
